newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady amid very thin talk.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady amid very thin talk.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Monday were little changed amid very thin talk, industry sources said.
"The market is very thin with most buyers still at the sidelines," one trader said. Traders said most players are watching the crude oil market closely as Iraq due to start exports from Tuesday.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $123-$126 per tonne and 380-cst at $128-$132. MDO and gasoil prices were quoted at $245-$250 and $254-$257 respectively.
